Longer and more demanding than the classic circuit; downstream dog-safety enrichment remains mandatory.

items.title: Assisted route and corrected Bai de Dones parking approved
items.routeIdentity: Attempt 2 found a source-traceable chairlift-assisted three-refuges circuit. Its official GPX also proves the previously approved parking coordinate is in the upper Cinque Torri area, not at Bai de Dones.

proposals.label: Three-refuges chairlift-assisted circuit
proposals.summary: Starts at Bai de Dones, uses the 5 Torri chairlift to Rifugio Scoiattoli, crosses the open-air museum, passes Rifugio Cinque Torri and returns through the forest to Bai de Dones.
warnings: This is explicitly a chairlift-assisted route, not an entirely walked loop.
Dogs are accepted on the 5 Torri lift but must be leashed and muzzled.
Corrected Bai de Dones parking way 900787870 is approved; enrichment and safety gates remain pending.

metrics.distanceAssessment: The official 204-point GPX is closed within 17 m and computes to 5.32 km. The page describes a chairlift-assisted itinerary, so transport and walking metrics must remain distinct.

findings: The earlier Bai de Dones parking approval is invalidated; the corrected parking candidate must pass its own human gate and does not identify which walking itinerary ORMA is offering.
Chairlift use materially changes distance, ascent, operating-season dependency and dog logistics.
An authoritative refuge source confirms the fully walked approach uses trail 425 and approximately 400 m ascent.
The same source confirms the assisted approach begins with the Bai de Dones chairlift and then descends on trail 439.
Attempt 2 found the official three-refuges GPX and a matching 5.32 km closed line.
The current OSM relation 11588900 identifies the CAI-surveyed trail 425 from Bai de Dones; relation 3170143 identifies trail 439.
The stored relation 6678431 was deleted in 2019 and was a footway-area multipolygon, never a hiking route.

The approved 46.508152, 12.046613 coordinate is about 1.38 km from the real Bai de Dones parking. Current OSM way 900787870 is a free gravel surface car park operated by Seggiovia 5 Torri at approximately 46.518917, 12.037604.
blockers: The corrected OSM way 900787870 parking is approved; retain the superseded coordinate only in audit history.
Do not treat the chairlift segment in the GPX as walked distance or ascent.
A complete fully walked Cinque Torri circuit is not part of the approved assisted route and would require a separate proposal.
humanChecks: No further parking or geometry choice review is required.
Review the enrichment and safety evidence before ORMA Verification.
